$comment: Behavioural conformance manifest for the Easy Agent clients. Each id names ONE scenario that every client's message-state-machine suite MUST cover, with the same assertions as the webui reference (abcp-sdk/webui/src/lib/messages.test.ts). `python3 conformance.py --check` fails if a client's suite does not reference every id, so a scenario cannot be silently dropped. The assertions themselves live in each client's native test (Kotlin/Dart/Swift) because the controllers are typed per language.

scenarios.why: an empty session boots with no optimistic bubbles
message-added -> deltas -> tool -> turn-complete -> reconcile; the user bubble is server-authored
a delta arriving before message-added must not duplicate the bubble
a new step message-added finalizes the prior streaming bubble
a replayed event (same eid) is applied exactly once
replayed deltas for a PERSISTED step must not duplicate its parts
tool-error marks the part error and keeps the bubble
a model error event adds a local error bubble and clears sending
a deliver failure surfaces a send error bubble
sending a new prompt clears a prior error bubble (transient state)
